**Yes, Sarah Chen could have approved this discount.**

Sarah Chen holds the title of Enterprise Account Executive. Under PRICING-POLICY-2025 (the policy in effect on 2025-09-23), Enterprise Account Executives are authorized to approve discounts of up to and including 15%. The requested discount of exactly 15% falls within her approval authority.

The customer's commercial eligibility is established by the active ACME-MFG-2025 Master Supply Agreement (effective 2025-04-01 through 2028-03-31), which provides for discounts up to 15% on the NS-500, and by the EXC-ACME-NS500-15 pricing exception (Schedule B to that agreement), which sets the maximum at 15% of list price. The request correctly relies on these special terms.

The policy rules are met: the discount is calculated against the current list price ($250,000), and the contract-specific pricing exception has been reviewed. The request may be approved.
